method: image_gen edit of the earlier sourced corner draft
prompt: Edit this existing transparent ornament into a game sprite optimized for display at only 8 to 12 pixels. Keep the same simple block-leaf and cream-square concept, but simplify to two or three large flat high-contrast shapes, with a clean bold dark outline. Make the entire ornament fill 85–90% of the square canvas width and height, centered, with only a narrow uniform transparent margin. Remove every stray pixel, glow, shadow, noise and semitransparent residue from the empty background; preserve a transparent alpha background. No text, no other objects, no frame, no mockup. The result must be one compact, very readable square sprite.
remaining: Independent Art review, transparency, small-size readability and actual gameplay fit for every frame proportion; do not treat as approved.
